title: Apply Knockback Rules
description: Defines how an entity applies knockback.

presets.description: Array of rules instances defining how knockback should be applied to the entity.

check_if_target_is_immersed_in_water.description: Whether or not the target should be fully immersed in water for the knockback rules to apply.

extra_knockback_approach.description: Defines the approach for combining extra knockback from enchantments or sprinting: - "reapply_default": Reapplies knockback again with default knockback parameters, i.

filter.description: Filter for the entity type that will be affected by these knockback rules.

horizontal_power.description: Power with which a target should be knocked backwards.

knockback_mode.description: Defines how knockback is applied to the target: - "relative_horizontal": Applies knockback along the horizontal direction from the attacker to the target.

scale_with_damage.description: Scaling factor to the magnitude of knockback based on the inverse square of the damage.

slowdown_scale.description: Scaling factor to apply to the target's velocity before applying knockback. Value must be <= 1.

vertical_power.description: Power with which a target should be knocked upwards.

vertical_velocity_cap.description: Maximum allowed Y velocity after target's knockback rules have been evaluated.
